Class ListEventQueue

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<SimEvent>
java.util.AbstractList<SimEvent>
java.util.ArrayList<SimEvent>
simEngine.ListEventQueue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<SimEvent>, Collection<SimEvent>, List<SimEvent>, RandomAccess, SequencedCollection<SimEvent>, EventQueue
public class ListEventQueue extends ArrayList<SimEvent> implements EventQueue
This class implements an event queue used internally by the Sim_system to manage the list of future and deferred Sim_events. It should not be needed in a user simulation. It works like a normal FIFO queue, but during insertion events are kept in order from the smallest time stamp to the largest. This means the next event to occur will be at the top of the queue. <P> The current implementation is uses a Vector to store the queue and is inefficient for popping and inserting elements because the rest of the array has to be moved down one space. A better method would be to use a circular array.
